description.value: Here, we describe the clinical and pathological characteristics of the 10 index patients and six of their affected relatives carrying a TBK1 mutation. We also compared the genotype–phenotype data of FTD patients with a TBK1 mutation with those of FTD patients with a causal mutation in GRN or C9orf72 and those of 259 patients with FTD without identified mutations.

value: With the current study we aimed to discover specific clinical characteristics which can suggest the presence of a TBK1 mutation.
In particular for patients with (a familial history of) both FTD and ALS, specific clinical characteristics could help in a clinically based differentiation with C9orf72 carriers.

spans.text: The   GRN   carriers were the only patient group in which there was a higher proportion of PPA diagnoses in comparison to behavioural variant FTD diagnoses (47.6% PPA versus 45.2% behavioural variant FTD).
